summary.headline: KwangjinInd issues KRW 10bn convertible bonds; maturity and conversion terms revised in correction filing
summary.what_happened: KwangjinInd (광진실업) filed a corrected report on Nov 25, 2026 on its convertible bond issuance decided on Nov 2, 2026. The corrected filing changes the maturity date from Nov 26, 2029 to Jan 14, 2030, the conversion price from KRW 3,850 to KRW 1,518 per share, and the conversion period and payment date, which is now Jan 14, 2027.
summary.why_it_matters: In Korea, convertible bond filings and corrections generally signal potential future dilution, since bonds may be converted into new shares at a set price, and changes to conversion price or share count can affect existing shareholders' ownership percentage. Corrections typically reflect changes in subscriber details or issuance terms, which shareholders may want to review in the full filing.
